title: Joint Petition of Boston Edison Company, Cambridge Electric Light Company, Canal Electric Company and Commonwealth Electric Company d/b/a NSTAR Electric Company for Approval of Merger pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 96 and in accordance with D.T.E. 05-85.
